messages:
marie: Quick note  opening a tiny PR to reconcile errref entries for 429/timeouts when customers are on Dedicated private endpoints. Found two broken links and an old curl snippet that assumes public routing.

ash: Good catch. Dedicated users need a note about SRV routing and a reminder to use the private base URL. Can you add an example for private-host header usage?

marie: Will do. Draft curl (private):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Host: private.redwood.customer.internal" \
  -d '{"input":"tiny"}' \
  "https://private-vpc.redwood.com/v1/generate?model=redwood-lite"
```
Also adding bullet: prefer parsing Retry-After and X-RW-Retry-Policy; do not auto-retry on 401/403.

doc-bot: Link-check: 2 broken anchors in /errref/private-migration.md. Add label `docs:snippets-changed`.

tony: I'll validate the Go snippet and switch to context.WithTimeout + defer cancel. Also add a one-line prompt trim pointer.

ash: Please include a short streaming note: if stream disconnects after tokens have been delivered, resume from last confirmed token instead of full restart.

marie: Thanks, team. PR in ~25m, tagging @tony @ash for quick review.
